RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is common in education, where women make up a large portion of staff and leadership; panel composition alone does not indicate bias. Raising gender without concrete evidence will likely harm your professional reputation and appear defensive.

Principal appointments depend heavily on interview performance, leadership vision, institutional fit, and references, rather than paper credentials alone. Her ten years of teaching and leadership coursework made her a qualified finalist.

Do not bring up the panel's demographics. Instead, follow up professionally on your request for written feedback to understand how candidates were evaluated. Only consider formal action if the documented rationale reveals clear procedural violations or objective unfairness.
